Hi @VicHY , The behavior you are describing actually points to two distinct issues overlapping—a Homey cache bug, and the physical calibration of the MTG075 radar itself. Here are a few investigation tracks to help us isolate the problem: The “Curtain” Type Bug: As mentioned earlier, Homey sometimes pulls old cached capabilities, forcing the device to switch to a curtain controller. If it stays as a curtain after updating to the latest test version and waiting a few minutes, you will need to remove and re-pair it specifically as a “Presence Sensor Radar” to force the correct driver to load. Stuck in “Occupied” Mode: When you mention it stops detecting presence/motion while lux and distance still fluctuate slightly, it highly suggests the sensor is actually stuck in the “Occupied” (Presence = true) state. Hi @VicHY , That is fantastic news! The “Repair” action successfully flushed the bad cache from Homey, which explains why your Lux and distance readings are finally accurate and why it stopped reverting to a Curtain device. Your current settings (Sensitivity at 5, Departure at 20s) are a very solid baseline for a bathroom environment. If you ever experience “ghost presence” again once you turn the exhaust fan back on, try slightly reducing the sensitivity to 4 or 3. I am currently finalizing the code for the “Ultimate Software Shield” update. Once it passes my local testing, I will push it to the Test channel and ping you here so you can try it out. Hi, Could you add support for the AOYAN AY-303Z Zigbee soil moisture sensor? It’s a white-label version of the HOBEIAN ZG-303Z, so hopefully it only needs its fingerprint added to the existing soil sensor driver. Device info: Manufacturer name: “AOYAN” Model ID: AY-303Z Endpoint 1: profile 260, device type 770 Input clusters: 0x0000, 0x0001, 0x0003, 0x0402, 0x0405, 0xEF00 Output clusters: 0x0003 Zigbee2MQTT handles it in the same definition as the ZG-303Z (zigbeeModel: ZG-303Z / AY-303Z / AY-302Z, COOLO CS-201Z). A ZHA quirk for the AY-303Z is also in progress (zigpy/zha-device-handlers PR #5352 ). One thing to be aware of: the native humidity cluster (0x0405) reports the soil moisture value, while the real ambient humidity comes from DP 109.
